request_reviews.rationale: Re-review (fpze, DC-0001920453-217abf613d), now SUPPORTED. The evidence matches my recomputation (68 day-first only: 39 unambiguous, 29 ambiguous; 78 ambiguous month-first; 2026-03-31 has none). The design is sound. Part (1), unambiguous coercion (first number above 12), is safe in the shared grammar. Part (2), an opt-in declaration of the exact day-first contexts, avoids any per-date heuristic, which would misread one of the two ambiguous groups. The tests cover a declared versus undeclared ambiguous date, an undeclared month-first context, an invalid date and an undeclared fund. Classification as verification_bug is right: published data are correct and the check cannot read the source. Two cautions for the owner. The declaration is pinned to one filing's contexts and will not carry forward: if the filer keeps mixing orders, each new quarter needs a fresh list, and the gate should keep reporting the exclusion until it does. The request should also state that the 18 production agentA findings return at the next batch regardless of this repair (stated in next_action).
